 <div class="wpb_raw_code wpb_raw_html wpb_content_element" >
 <div class="wpb_wrapper">
 <img decoding="async" class="img-responsive " src="https://100x100fun.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/chica-relajada-en-nuestro-hotel-de-tarifa.jpg" alt="Chica relajada en nuestro hotel de Tarifa" />
 </div>

</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="special-text"><p><span><strong>Welcome to 100% Fun</strong>, designed to offer you a unique experience by the sea. Located just a few metres from the stunning <strong>Valdevaqueros Beach</strong>, with over 4 kilometres of fine sand, it’s the perfect spot for lovers of <em><a href="https://100x100fun.com/en/kitesurf/">kitesurfing</a></em>, windsurfing, wingfoiling, or simply for those looking to unwind with the family. </span></p>
<p><span>At <strong>Hotel 100% Fun</strong>, you’ll find a warm and welcoming atmosphere where relaxation and fun go hand in hand. Enjoy <em><a href="https://100x100fun.com/en/100-fun-rooms/">our rooms</a></em> surrounded by tropical gardens, the delicious cuisine at <em><a href="https://100x100fun.com/en/restaurant/">our restaurant</a></em>, and the laid-back vibe that defines Tarifa. </span></p>
<p><span>Whether you&#8217;re after a sporty getaway, a family break to disconnect, or just want to soak up the sun and sea, <strong>Hotel 100% Fun is the place to be</strong>. </span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-temp="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" data-vc-stretch-content="true" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_row-no-padding"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="empty-space marg-lg-b120 marg-xs-b50"></div></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row-full-width vc_clearfix"></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="main-heading"><span class="subtitle">Our rooms</span><h2 class="title">Comfort and nature</h2></div><div class="empty-space marg-lg-b25"></div>
